task_completion.description: Create a new collection named 'History of Computing' in the Zotero library.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The left-hand sidebar of Zotero shows a new collection folder titled 'History of Computing'.

task_completion.description: Identify papers published before 1970 (e.g., works by Turing, Einstein, Shannon).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent selects or highlights items in the main library view where the 'Date' column shows a year prior to 1970.

task_completion.description: Add the tag 'classic-era' to the identified papers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Tags' tab in the right-hand info pane or the tag selector in the bottom-left shows the tag 'classic-era' (exact spelling/lowercase) applied to the selected papers.

task_completion.description: Move all papers published before 1970 into the 'History of Computing' collection.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'History of Computing' collection is selected, and the center pane displays the classic papers (e.g., 1905, 1936, 1950).

task_completion.description: Ensure no papers from 1970 or later (modern ML papers) are in the 'History of Computing' collection.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'History of Computing' collection is visible, and no papers with dates like 2012, 2017, or 2020 are present in the list.

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI to perform tasks rather than just command-line database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Zotero menus, right-click context menus, or drag-and-drop actions.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually change the publication years of papers to force them into the criteria.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Date' field in the item details pane remains consistent with the original paper facts (e.g., Turing 1936, Vaswani 2017).

integrity.description: The agent added the tag through the Zotero interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Add' button in the Tags pane is used, or the tag is typed into the Zotero tag entry field.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The library contains 10 classic papers (pre-1970) and 8 modern papers (2012-2020). Classic papers include authors like Einstein (1905), Turing (1936), Shannon (1948), and McCarthy (1959). Modern papers include 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017) and 'ImageNet' (2012). The target collection name is 'History of Computing' and the required tag is 'classic-era' (must be lowercase). Exactly 10 papers should be moved and tagged.
